messages:
lucy_marketing: Heads-up  we found a spike in q4 p95 on slide 6 vs the FP baseline. Need a defendable reproducer pack + short appendix for legal/webinar. Ask (deadline tomorrow 11am PT): 1) 25 sanitized payloads (label short/med/long/edge), highlight the reproducer payload id, 2) single-copy run command for Hosted + Dedicated, 3) per-request latencies + token counts (no prompt text), 4) a tiny repro script that triggers the spike on q4 (payload id 17), 5) provenance (run_by, UTC ISO, model_tag, commit, quant_recipe), 6) suggested neutral PR-safe sentence if numbers hold. @ash_runtime @mike_eng @jude_metrics :eyes:

ash_runtime: Ack. We'll investigate. Quick clarifiers: which exact model tag? streaming or non-stream timing for the numbers? Do you want both hosted and dedicated runs? Also, do you prefer warmup=200 tokens or 500?

lucy_marketing: Use redwood-v2-7b:stable (the slide referenced q4), non-stream token timing only for the claim. Include both Hosted and Dedicated numbers. Warmup 200 is fine for the appendix; include a note if you also ran with 500 and saw differences.

mike_eng: We'll instrument the quantized execution path. Is it ok to include a single flamegraph + a short trace for the repro case in the private artifact (not public)? That will help the eng notes in the deck.

ljude_metrics: I'll need raw per-request latencies and token counts to compute CI and to verify the spike's statistical significance. Recommend 4 independent trials (fresh process restarts) for the repro payload and 3 trials for the full pack.

ash_runtime: Plan: create repro_2416300000/{payloads.json,manifest.csv,repro_payload_17.txt,run_hosted.sh,run_dedicated.sh,per_request_*.csv,summary.csv,README.md,flamegraphs.tgz}. Repro command we'll include (copy-paste):

`./run_dedicated.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:stable --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --batch 1 --seq 512 --warmup 200 --repeats 4 --focus-payload 17 --out out/2416300000`

ash_runtime: Hosted snippet (uses API key env var):

`REDWOOD_API_KEY=... ./run_hosted.sh --model redwood-v2-7b:stable --quant q4 --payloads payloads.json --batch 1 --seq 512 --warmup 200 --repeats 4 --focus-payload 17`

mike_eng: We'll include the flamegraph + a one-paragraph root-cause note (hypotheses: quant kernel crossing point, cache alignment, or tokenization edge-case). That stays in the private artifact. Public README will only contain measured numbers + provenance + conservative suggested sentence.

storage-bot: artifact uploaded: gs://redwood-bench/repro/2416300000/repro-pack.tar.gz (payloads.json, manifest.csv, repro_payload_17.txt, run_hosted.sh, run_dedicated.sh, per_request_hosted.csv, per_request_dedicated.csv, summary.csv, README.md, flamegraphs.tgz)

ljude_metrics: Quick ask: please ensure per_request CSVs include columns: trial_id, request_idx, payload_id, latency_ms, token_count. No prompt text. I'll run bootstrap CI and add an explicit p95 delta test for payload 17 across q4 vs fp.

lucy_marketing: Also: some payloads originally contained verbatim customer text. Please sanitize and mark sanitized_flag in manifest. Legal will review.

ash_runtime: All sanitized where needed, manifest contains sanitized_flag. README includes provenance line exactly as requested: `run_by:ash_runtime; run_ts:2026-03-23T06:45:00Z; model_tag:redwood-v2-7b:stable; commit:abc123def456; quant_recipe:recipe_q4_v2`

mike_eng: Suggested conservative one-liner for PR (if numbers hold): "On redwood-v2-7b:stable with q4 recipe_q4_v2, measured p95 latency for the quantized variant was X ms (+Y% vs FP, 95% CI [a,b])." We'll let metrics fill X/Y/CI in README.

lucy_marketing: Perfect. Once we validate the artifacts we'll decide whether to call out payload 17 in the FAQ or keep it internal. Thanks all 680 :thumbsup:
